caption: The drawing depicts a single hat positioned in profile facing to the left, rendered in various shades of reddish-brown. The hat is adorned with a large, prominent feather plume that curves along the top edge, matching the reddish-brown hue of the main body of the hat. The brim of the hat is wide and gently undulating, featuring ruched or gathered fabric. Along the crown of the hat, there is a band with intricate black lace or embroidery, bordered below by a wavy blue ribbon or trim that stands out against the brown tones. Below the brim and attached at the center are two dark brown or black chin straps that loop downward in an oval shape. The background is plain, consisting of an off-white or beige color with no additional objects or patterns. There is a handwritten inscription at the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Hat
